Guide to set up FCSExpress site license

Please follow the procedures in sequence.
Register for De Novo Software account. Your university email is required. 
https://denovosoftware.com/register/
Email XiaoxuanFan, include your lab name, whether you are our facility user and how many licenses your lab already has.
Register for site license: https://www.denovosoftware.com/RegisterForSiteLicense/?SignupCode=UMGCCC+FCSS 
You will receive the approval email within one day. 
Download at:  https://denovosoftware.com/full-access/download-landing/
Launch the installer. Choose “Stand Alone” when prompted. 
Run FCS Express 7. Follow the wizard: 
1st option “Automatically through this wizard, I already have a De Novo Software account”. 
Enter your De Novo Software Account credentials. 
Choose configuration file for your Flow Cytometry site license. 
Complete the wizard and FCS Express 7 will launch.
